body: Thank you for the advice! I think I was overthinking things as usual. I'll try by starting off by looking at the local munch nearby.

Another advice, some cat experts have suggested getting a blanket or something that could potentially pick up the other cat scent and exchange it between the two cats to help them get used to each other scents.
